page.layout: One printed page, framed by a woodcut border. Running head with page number at top; title block centred; then one text column with a historiated initial. No notes in margins. Digitiser credit at foot is excluded.

main_text.head: PHILOCHEMI-CIS HELIOPHILIS HELI-ophilus Philochemicus, NICOLAUS NIGER HAPELI-US Anagrammatizomenos, S.
main_text.p: AD asserendam veritatē artis Chrysochemicæ (quanquam ea multo-rum impostura pessi-mè audit, & à prudentibus ac cæ-tera doctis, quasi nulla esset planè proscribitur) hanc disquisitionem instituere visum est, qua causæ a-periuntur ejus difficultatis, ac quid sentiendum de ea sit, certis indicijs ostenditur, HELIA artis (quē vocant) in lucem producto. Itaq; patientem Lector huic dis-qui-

page.notes: The first letter A is a large woodcut historiated initial, joined to "D" of "Dasserendam" as printed ("AD asserendam"). Some letters in the body are worn; "Itaq;" and "Lector" are read as printed. Catchword "qui-" is a line-end hyphenated word, kept in the text.
